scope: All published MCP prompt examples and generated source capability claims; no production business writes, login consent or customer data reads.

findingsResolved: Order-symbol lookup dependencies added before inspect/cancel/payment/resend.
Waitlist form/order discovery added; proposal expiry refresh explained outside prompt.
Program venue lookup added; activity-count tool removed from change-history example.
Counseling described as scheduled sessions, without a free-capacity claim.
Scanner resolves ticket from selected order instead of requesting internal identifiers.
Business prompts simplified; hardcoded Europe/Prague removed.
Schedule reads occasion settings and uses natural event-time instruction, clarifying missing timezone rather than guessing.
Seating prompt describes inspecting data, without promising a plan image renderer.

timezoneEvidence.application: RightsService selects the occasion timezone; OccasionTimeContext owns its default and instant conversion.
timezoneEvidence.mcp: forms.save accepts ISO instants with offsets; forms.inspect does not return a resolved timezone. occasions.settings.inspect provides the saved override, not a resolved inheritance chain.
timezoneEvidence.policy: Use the event time settings. If the connection cannot determine them, clarify before saving. No locale/device-based guess.
